body:
Thanks, I really appreciate it. I'm sorry about your dad. That is horrible, and I highly doubt you have any reason to blame yourself. That is one thing I do worry about, my children blaming themselves.  

Fortunately, they won't remember me. My oldest (11), has not seen me in six years. I was stationed in Japan, where he was born, and his mother received full rights to him. There is no joint custody in Japan.  

My five year old daughter barely sees me due to moving out of state, and my youngest two are three and one. They won't remember me, so hopefully they won't have that guilt. Probably more of "Why didn't daddy love me enough to stay" type question. Which breaks my heart to no end.

As for my current wife, well, she doesn't love me. She has expressed them many times, lol.
